contract.new: Borrowed object from the context's runtime, returned uniquely owned stable native cell. Preserve actual pending before brand/allocation. Reject nonobjects; no guest property or constructor operations. Allocate the cell and embedded weak record together at original Global creation, then take one external counted value root.
contract.set_weak: No allocation and no native-entry rejection. Link the actual embedded weak record to the target before releasing the external strong root. A repeated or empty transition is harmless. Preserve the first actual pending/fatal reason around retirement; do not classify DATA or poll another policy.
contract.get: Owned duplicate of a still-live target, or undefined for empty/dead/null. No public WeakRef, kept-object table, guest call, or new allocation. Use the cell's actual runtime. A finalizer must not resurrect a zero-refcount queued target, free_mark object, or target already selected for cycle removal.
contract.free: Unique caller destroys its cell while the runtime remains alive. Unlink a live weak record without releasing a borrowed value, or clear the strong value before its actual release. Retain cell storage during reentrant finalization, expose empty to Get, and suppress recursive disposal until the outer retirement finishes. Preserve first actual pending/fatal. Null is harmless.
contract.lifetime: VM-owning thread only; all cells are freed before JS_FreeRuntime. No cross-runtime or post-runtime access. SDK explicitly confirmed this selected consumer lifetime.
contract.gc: Strong value is an external native root, so it is not duplicated as a wrapper-internal JS_MarkValue edge. A weak link owns no target reference. Native cell itself has no JS wrapper.

c_mapping.guard: Get additionally checks actual zero reference count, free_mark, and REMOVE_CYCLES+mark, covering other finalizers reading a target whose actual free_object has not yet run.
c_mapping.cleanup: Use the existing runtime actual-pending reducer from the continuation unit, with no reducer algorithm change.
